prompt: What is the name of the Australian novelist who is one of only five writers to have won the Booker Prize twice and also won the Jerusalem Prize?
answer: The novelist is **J. M. Coetzee**. The South African-born Australian writer won the Booker Prize twice—for *Life & Times of Michael K* (1983) and *Disgrace* (1999)—and received the **Jerusalem Prize** in 1987.
